content: Some methods were proposed in the multimodal literature to effectively treat informative missing modes or “informative missingness”, which is a characteristic refereed in the literature as learning with missing modalities BIBREF22 . In this work, we directly model the news missingness as a feature of our text model temporal sequence by using the method initially proposed in BIBREF45 , BIBREF46 for clinical data with missing measurements and applied in the context of financial forecasting in BIBREF47 . Specifically, we implement the Zeros & Imputation (ZI) method BIBREF46 in order to jointly learn the price mode and news relationship across all days of market activity.
